n, k = map(int, input().split())
data = list(map(int, input().split()))

parityArray = []
for i in range(n):
    if i == 0:
        parityArray.append(1 if data[i] % 2 == 0 else -1)
    else:
        parityArray.append(parityArray[i - 1] + 1 if data[i] % 2 == 0 else parityArray[i - 1] - 1)

diffList = []
for i in range(n - 1):
    diff = abs(data[i + 1] - data[i])
    diffList.append((diff, i))

diffList.sort(key=lambda d: d[0])

total = 0
for diff, index in diffList:
    if k >= diff and parityArray[index] == 0:
        k -= diff
        total += 1

print(total)
